icons.name: streak-flame
icons.heading: Streak flame

Light: the flame gathers low and wide, then flares 14 percent taller and narrower on its base, rebounds and settles, and an ember rises off its right shoulder and fades. Strong: a deeper gather, a 16 percent flare with a lean that swings back through two smaller beats, and two embers rise in turn. The inner tongue rides with the flame.
